title: Three sharing the rice, and another to bring home
odia:
ଚାଉଳ ସେରକୁ ତିନି ପରାଣୀ
ଆହୁରି ଯାଉଚି ବୋହୁକୁ ଆଣି।
literal_meaning: Three people for a ser of rice, and still going to bring home a daughter-in-law.
meaning_odia: ସେରେ ଚାଉଳ ପାଇଁ ଆଗରୁ ତିନି ପରାଣୀ ଅଛନ୍ତି, ତଥାପି ବୋହୁ ଆଣିବାକୁ ଯାଉଛନ୍ତି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ସମ୍ବଳରେ ଆଉ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ନେବାର ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ଅଛି କି ନାହିଁ, ସେହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠୁଛି।
explanation: The verse first counts the people sharing a given amount of rice, then adds the prospect of another household member. Read editorially, it questions taking on an added responsibility without considering the means to support it. The concern is provision and planning, not the worth of the person arriving.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A small group already stretches its shared supplies but invites another participant without arranging more. A reader recalls the saying’s contrast between present provision and a new commitment.
cultural_context: The count of three gives the first line a concrete scale. Bringing a daughter-in-law home supplies the next change in that count. The verse leaves the identities of the three and the period covered by the rice unstated.

odia_summary: ଆଉ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ନେବା ଆଗରୁ ସମ୍ବଳକୁ ବିଚାର କରିବା।
english_summary: An added responsibility calls for attention to the means available.
